entries.text: SQLite TPC-DS translation marks the TPC-DS `DATE` columns through the runtime's `mark_date_columns` rewrite on the parsed tree (`translate_sql_query(date_columns=..)`), so Q72's `d3.d_date > d1.d_date + 5` adds five whole days to the date text instead of adding 5 to the leading number of the text. Q72 is the only shipped TPC-DS query whose SQLite text changes; TPC-DS Q72 results published for SQLite were computed with the unmarked predicate.
